selector_strategy_note: No data-cy or data-testid attributes were found anywhere in the application. All selectors rely on stable class names (Tailwind) and button text. Recommend requesting dev team to add data-cy attributes.

modules.selector_notes: Dashboard is a summary/stats page only. No table, no CRUD actions. Read-only access check is: body does not contain 'not authorized' or '403'.
modules.flow_deviations: No list, no row interactions. Read check = page loads without access-denied message.

modules.selector_notes: No data-cy attributes. Table uses Tailwind classes 'min-w-full table-fixed divide-y divide-gray-300'. Rows: 'hover:bg-gray-50 transition-colors duration-200'. Checkboxes: 'h-4 w-4 text-[#00a6fb] focus:ring-[#00a6fb]'. Create button text: 'Walk-in Sample' (not 'New' or 'Create'). Slide-over panel class: 'animate-slide-in-right'. CRITICAL: Approve/Save buttons inside slide-over are LOCATION-GATED — the testemp account saw 'You do not have access to this client location. Actions are not available.' instead of action buttons. Need an account with matching location access to verify approve button selector.
modules.flow_deviations: Row click opens a right-side slide-over panel (div.animate-slide-in-right), NOT a centered modal. Approve button lives inside slide-over but is hidden when location access is denied. Action menu after checkbox tick showed 'Send for Activation' option — no 'Delete' option was found for Reception role.
